scope: Official public documentation snapshot for future subtitle-boundary provider comparison; this is transport design material, not an approved ZEV contract.

standardPricingUsdPerMillionTokens.longContextRule: Prompts over 272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and 1.5x output for the full request.
standardPricingUsdPerMillionTokens.cacheWriteRule: Cache writes are billed at 1.25x the uncached input rate.

dataHandling.trainingDefault: API data is not used to train or improve OpenAI models unless the customer explicitly opts in.
dataHandling.defaultAbuseMonitoringRetention: up to 30 days, subject to stated legal and safety exceptions
dataHandling.responsesApplicationState: Responses API response data is retained for at least 30 days by default or when store=true.
dataHandling.zeroDataRetention: Eligible approved organizations can use Zero Data Retention; for those organizations store is treated as false.
dataHandling.designImplication: A future transport must set store=false and must not claim zero retention unless the project is actually approved and configured for ZDR.
